a['t']=pd.to_datetime(a['Giờ'])
def qty(s):
    import re; return float(re.match(r'-?[\d.,]+',str(s).strip()).group().replace(',','.'))
a['q']=a['Số lượng hàng'].map(qty)
# order-level: status per order (take any non-null), returned if neg qty or status
def stt(g):
    s=' '.join(g['Ghi chú TT'].astype(str)).lower()
    bad=('hủy' in s) or ('huỷ' in s) or ('trả' in s) or (g.q<0).any()
    return pd.Series({'bad':bad,'t':g.t.min()})
